contexts.text: Circumcision was the covenant here treated of, by which is meant circumcision of the heart, which is that of those who are in love; circumcision was a representative of regeneration through love. Illustrated.
Wherefore wherever circumcision is mentioned, nothing else is meant than love and charity, and thence life.
Why the sabbath and circumcision are called signs of the covenant. Illustrated.
That man must first remove loves and their filthy cupidities, and thus be purified, is what is represented by circumcision.

Every male to be circumcised () = purity... Circumcision, or the cutting off of the foreskin, signified the removal of those things which hinder and defile heavenly love, and which are evils of cupidities, especially of the cupidities of self-love, and the falsities thence. Explained.

That circumcision is only a sign of a covenant or of conjunction, is evident from the fact, that the circumcision of the foreskin is nothing at all without the circumcision of the heart; and that it is the circumcision of the heart, which is purification from those filthy loves, which is signified. Illustrated. AC 6804:11.

When the Angels have the idea of purification from filthy natural things, with extreme rapidity there is represented something like circumcision in the World of Spirits... They with whom this rapid circumcision was represented in the World of Spirits were wanting to be admitted into Heaven, and before they were admitted this was represented. Hence it is evident why command was given to Joshua that the people should be circumcised, when having crossed the Jordan, they were entering Canaan. ().
Ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin () = the removal of the love of self and of the world. Circumcision = purification from filthy loves. AC 2042. AC 2044. AC 2045.
Circumcising shall be circumcised () = that they shall completely remove from themselves the loves of self and of the world... Circumcision = purification from the loves of self and of the world.
He who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin () = him who is in self-love. Explained.
He circumcised the flesh of their foreskin () = their purification and righteousness from the Lord. To be circumcised = to be purified from the loves of self and of the world.

In his circumcising the flesh of bis foreskin () = when He entirely expelled the evils of the external man. To be circumcised = to be purified from the loves of self and of the world, or what is the same, from evils, for all evils are thence. AC 2110.

Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael his son () = that when the Lord conjoined His human essence with His Divine essence, He also conjoined with Himself all others who become rational by truth, and saved them... To be circumcised = to be purified, and when predicated of the Lord, = to be glorified.
They were circumcised by him () = that they were justified by the Lord. To be circumcised = to be purified.
Abraham circumcised Isaac his son () = the purification of the Rational.
Circumcision in the Ancient Church represented that man was to be purified from the loves of self and of the world... AC 2634. AC 2799:6.

The word circumcision was used to distinguish between those who were of the Church and those who were not, for circumcision = recession from filthy loves... and accession to heavenly loves... thus accession to the Church.

The Most Ancient Church knew nothing of circumcision, but only the Ancient Church; from this Church circumcision emanated to many nations, and was enjoined on Abraham and his descendants not as anything new... and became to them a sign that they were of the Church... Circumcision, however, was only a sign representative of purification from the love of self and of the world; on being purified from which they are spiritually circumcised, and are said to be circumcised as to the heart. Illustrated.

In the circumcising of every male, as they are circumcised () = if they were initiated thereby in the representatives of these things as to mere externals. To be circumcised = an external representative, a sign that they were of the Church.
Hamor and Shechem sinned enormously in receiving circumcision. Explained.
They circumcised every male, all that went out of the gate of his city () = accession to external things.
The pain after circumcision = cupidity. Explained.
The reason circumcision was done with knives of stone = that purification from filthy loves should be effected through truths of faith. Explained. AC 9088:2. AE 701:25.

A bridegroom of bloods for the circumcisions () = that although the internal was full of violence and hostility to truth and good, still circumcision was to be received as a sign representative of purification from filthy loves. AC 8000.
Let all his males be circumcised () = that his truth is to be purified from impure loves.
Circumcision signified purification from these filthy loves.

Wherefore it is said that they should circumcise themselves to Jehovah, and remove the foreskins of the heart (), that is, that they should purify themselves from such things as suffocate or render unfruitful the truths and goods of faith. References.
By those who are circumcised are meant those who are in spiritual love.
That by circumcision was represented purification from the evils which are of merely natural love, is evident from these passages. Illustrated.
To circumcise the heart or the foreskin of the heart (, ) = to purify themselves from evils.
Baptism was instituted in place of circumcision, because by the circumcision of the foreskin was represented the circumcision of the heart... General article.
The primary thing which distinguished the Israelitish Church from the other Churches in the Asiatic world, and afterwards from the Christian Church, was circumcision.
Circumcision signified the rejection of the concupiscences of the flesh, and thus purification from evils... TCR 675:2, Illustrated.
That circumcision was instituted as a sign that the men of the Israelitish Church were of the posterity of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Illustrated.
As fruits signified the goods of life with man... it was commanded that the fruits of trees... should be circumcised ().
The reason a covenant was made by circumcision, was that circumcision represented purification from the loves of self and of the world, which are corporeal and earthly loves, and their removal.
